# Evidence for every row (two independent sources each, per 26 SOP):
#   1. the assignment in create(...)  -> what is stored
#   2. the use in execute(...)        -> what the value means at run time
# Shared pattern for all GameCommand subclasses:
#   a = player id   <- create() stores player.getId(); execute() resolves it back with
#   b = the command's own unit id (or an id array of units, or a group id - see below)
# Coordinate fields (float pairs) are X first, Y second. Proven twice:
#   - TerrainGrid indexes tiles as n * this.width + i4 with the SECOND argument as the row
#     (lines 90/106/147), so the first argument is the column X, the second the row Y.
